title: A description rename updates the core entry to Core for the new description
custom_preconds: Part X with a Core Charge (core part exists).
custom_steps:
1. Edit X, change Description to "New desc"
  2. Save
  3. Open the core part (GET /api/inventory/parts/{core_part_id})
custom_expected:
1. Hint shows if stocked elsewhere
  2. Saved
  3. Core name reads "Core for New desc"; same part number
